atoms.text: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is one of the most famous and respected classical composers in history. Mozart was born in Salzburg, Austria in 1756. He began writing music when he was 5 years old. Mozart was extremely talented: he played several musical instruments and wrote operas and other music for orchestra and piano. Nearly 300 years later, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is still celebrated for his musical talents.

atoms.a: What is the main idea of this passage?

b.sound: Mozart was a talented composer from Austria who is still respected today.
Mozart was a terrible composer from Austria who is still hated today.
Mozart is a famous scientist from Austria.
Mozart is still celebrated for his musical talents.
There was a great film about Mozart.
